Read Distribution and Taxonomy Analysis

Read length distribution of the PacBio HiFi reads

Taxonomic composition and read GC/coverage

The composition panel uses Kraken2 (PlusPFP) phylum-level assignments; phyla below 5% of a library’s reads are collapsed to “Other”. The GC/coverage panel plots per-read GC content (seqkit fx2tab) against per-read median 21-mer self-coverage (KAT sect) for the adapter-filtered HiFi reads, coloured by the same phylum categories. Coverage is a proxy for how often a molecule was sampled, not a per-base assembly coverage. Category summaries are written to data/blobplot-category-summary-by-isolate.tsv.

Finding

The full-read profiles reveal taxon-associated GC and coverage patterns. Pseudomonadota is concentrated at relatively high GC content and low 21-mer coverage, while Bacteroidota tends toward lower GC content and low coverage. Oomycota often has higher coverage than these bacterial groups but overlaps substantially with Streptophyta and unclassified reads. GC content and coverage can therefore help identify some non-target populations, but a simple threshold on these axes would not cleanly isolate Oomycota-assigned reads. Reads unclassified by Kraken2 should not be assumed to be contaminants.
